name: 95135 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95135 (San Jose) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95135 (San Jose) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 8 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
